title: On the global behavior of mappings and the correspondence of boundaries
summary: We consider families of mappings with moduli inequalities, having different definition domains. Under some additional assumptions we have proved that such families are uniformly equicontinuous. We have considered four main cases: when mappings are homeomorphisms and corresponding domains have simple geometry; when similar mappings have branch points; when domains with complex geometry are considered, but mappings still are homeomorphisms; and when similar mappings have branch points.
